summary: Pan American Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 16, 2026, reporting estimated mineral reserves and mineral resources as at June 30, 2026. Proven and probable reserves contain approximately 511.1 million ounces of silver and 6.3 million ounces of gold, with measured and indicated resources of 1,126.7 Moz silver and 7.5 Moz gold. Figures include Pan American's 44% attributable share of Juanicipio following completion of the MAG Silver Corp. acquisition on September 4, 2025. This is a routine operational disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply.
